release_notes:
v1.0.11+18 - Live Video Screen Banner & Strict Student Guardrail
- Interactive Live Video Screen Banner: Student dashboard displays teacher's live camera and studio stream preview with 1-tap entry into the classroom
- Strict Faculty Guardrail: Prevents students from creating phantom rooms, waiting in dead channels, or initiating broadcasts
- Auto-disconnect and cleanup when faculty concludes a live masterclass
- Director Stealth Proctor & Speak/Intervene Agora RTC integration
